programme.desc: A demon raised from infancy after being conjured by and rescued from the Nazis, grows up to become a defender against the forces of darkness.

programme.title: Deepwater Horizon
programme.desc: A dramatization of the disaster in April 2010, when the offshore drilling rig called the Deepwater Horizon exploded, resulting in the worst oil spill in American history.

programme.title: Rise of the Planet of the Apes
programme.desc: A scientist's quest to find a cure for Alzheimer's disease unintentionally results in a highly intelligent chimpanzee, which may signal the end of man's dominion over Earth.

programme.title: Kong: Skull Island
programme.desc: Scientists, soldiers and adventurers encounter the mighty Kong and other monstrous creatures after traveling to an uncharted island in the Pacific Ocean.

programme.title: War on Everyone
programme.desc: Two corrupt cops, who make money blackmailing criminals, come up against one who may be far more dangerous than both of them.

programme.title: On Becoming a Guinea Fowl
programme.desc: On an empty road in the middle of the night, Shula stumbles across the body of her uncle. As the funeral unfolds, the cousins unveil the buried secrets of their Zambian family in a vibrant reckoning with the lies we tell ourselves.

programme.title: The Lord of the Rings: The War of the Rohirrim
programme.desc: A sudden attack by Wulf, a ruthless Dunlending lord, forces Helm Hammerhand and his people to make a daring last stand in the ancient stronghold of the Hornburg. Finding herself in a desperate situation, Helm's daughter must lead the resistance.

programme.title: Bad Santa
programme.desc: Two criminals (Billy Bob Thornton, Tony Cox) disguise themselves as St. Nick and an elf to rob stores at Christmastime.

programme.title: Bad Santa 2
programme.desc: Fueled by cheap whiskey and greed, a foulmouthed criminal (Billy Bob Thornton), his mean mother (Kathy Bates) and their angry sidekick (Tony Cox) conspire to bilk a Chicago charity on Christmas Eve.

programme.title: Aftersun
programme.desc: Years after their last vacation, Sophie reflects on the rare time spent with her loving, idealistic father, attempting to reconcile the father she knew with the man she didn't.

programme.title: The Alto Knights
programme.desc: In the 1950s, New York crime bosses Frank Costello and Vito Genovese vie for control of the streets. Once the best of friends, petty jealousies and a series of betrayals place them on a deadly collision course that reshapes organized crime forever.

programme.title: Casino
programme.desc: A New York bookie (Robert De Niro) and his pal (Joe Pesci) turn a Las Vegas casino into an empire, then one's money-hungry wife (Sharon Stone) helps bring it down.

programme.title: Criminal
programme.desc: Hoping to stop a diabolical plot, the CIA implants the memories and skills of a dead agent (Ryan Reynolds) into the mind of a dangerous convict (Kevin Costner).

programme.title: Cleaner
programme.desc: Radical activists take 300 hostages at an energy company's annual gala in a high-rise building. It's now up to a former soldier who works as a window cleaner to save the hostages trapped inside, including her younger brother.

programme.title: The Meg
programme.desc: A massive creature attacks a deep-sea submersible, leaving it disabled and trapping the crew at the bottom of the Pacific Ocean. With time running out, a rescue diver must now confront an unimaginable threat -- a 75-foot-long prehistoric shark.

programme.title: The Legend of Ochi
programme.desc: In a remote village on the island of Carpathia, a shy farm girl named Yuri is raised to fear elusive animals known as ochi. But when Yuri discovers a wounded baby ochi has been left behind, she escapes on a quest to bring him home.

programme.title: Land of the Lost
programme.desc: A time-space vortex sucks a scientific has-been (Will Ferrell) and his companions (Anna Friel, Danny R. McBride) into an alternate dimension populated by dinosaurs and painfully slow creatures called Sleestaks.

programme.title: Inception
programme.desc: A thief (Leonardo DiCaprio) who enters people's dreams and steals their secrets gets a shot at redemption when he is given the dangerous task of planting an idea in someone's subconscious.

programme.title: Hot Tub Time Machine 2
programme.desc: The magical hot tub sends Lou (Rob Corddry), Nick (Craig Robinson) and Jacob (Clark Duke) to the year 2025 to prevent an unknown assailant from shooting Lou.

programme.title: Drinking Buddies
programme.desc: Although they're both dating other people, two co-workers (Olivia Wilde, Jake Johnson) hang out together in bars and try to ignore their mutual attraction.

programme.title: Green Lantern
programme.desc: The Green Lanterns have little regard for humans, who have been unable to harness the powers of the ring each member wears. But Jordan, a test pilot, may be the corps' only hope when an enemy called Parallax threatens the universal balance of power.

programme.title: Godzilla x Kong: The New Empire
programme.desc: Godzilla and the almighty Kong face a colossal threat hidden deep within the planet, challenging their very existence and the survival of the human race.

programme.title: Donyale Luna: Supermodel
programme.desc: The life and career of Donyale Luna, who was one of the first Black models to appear on the cover of Vogue.

programme.title: Elizabeth Taylor: The Lost Tapes
programme.desc: An unprecedented exploration into the life of Elizabeth Taylor, Hollywood's quintessential star. Access to Taylor's personal archives and hours of newly unearthed, intimate audio interviews with journalist Richard Meryman.

programme.title: My Mom Jayne
programme.desc: Mariska Hargitay's journey to understand and embrace the public and private legacy of her mother, Hollywood icon Jayne Mansfield.

programme.title: The Hunger Games
programme.desc: A resourceful teen takes her younger sister's place in a brutal contest in which youths from each of 12 districts fight to the death on live television.

programme.title: The Hunger Games: Catching Fire
programme.desc: After their unprecedented victory in the 74th Hunger Games, Katniss Everdeen and Peeta Mellark embark on a Victors Tour. Katniss senses rebellion is stirring, but a cruel change in the upcoming 75th Hunger Games may change Panem forever.

programme.title: The Hunger Games: Mockingjay, Part 1
programme.desc: After shattering the games forever, Katniss (Jennifer Lawrence) finds herself in District 13, fighting to save Peeta (Josh Hutcherson) and a nation moved by her courage.

programme.title: The Hunger Games: Mockingjay, Part 2
programme.desc: Katniss faces mortal traps, deadly enemies and moral choices when she and her closest friends leave District 13 to assassinate President Snow and liberate the citizens of war-torn Panem.

programme.title: Wonder Woman
programme.desc: After leaving her all-female island for the first time, Wonder Woman (Gal Gadot) discovers her full powers and true destiny while fighting alongside men in a war to end all wars.

programme.title: Wonder Woman 1984
programme.desc: Wonder Woman musters all of her strength, wisdom and courage as she finds herself squaring off against Maxwell Lord and the Cheetah, a villainess who possesses superhuman strength and agility.

Unfortunately, he is implicated in the fights and conspiracies among the triad forces. When his good friend is hunted down by the triad, Neng must team up with the residents of Kowloon Walled City to fight back and save his friend.

programme.title: Iron Squad W

programme.title: Shazam!
programme.desc: We all have a superhero inside us, it just takes a bit of magic to bring it out. In Billy Batson’s (Asher Angel) case, by shouting out one word—SHAZAM!—this streetwise 14-year-old foster kid can turn into the adult Super Hero Shazam (Zachary Levi), courtesy of an ancient wizard (Djimon Hounsou). Still a kid at heart—inside a ripped, godlike body—Shazam revels in this adult version of himself by doing what any teen would do with superpowers: have fun with them! Can he fly? Does he have X-ray vision? Can he shoot lightning out of his hands? Can he skip his social studies test? Shazam sets out to test the limits of his abilities with the joyful recklessness of a child. But he’ll need to master these powers quickly in order to fight the deadly forces of evil controlled by Dr. Thaddeus Sivana (Mark Strong).

programme.title: The Man With The Iron Fists 2
programme.desc: Thaddeus diserang dalam perjalanannya ke Kuil Wu Chi, lalu diselamatkan oleh suatu pasangan yang mengobati lukanya dan menawarinya tempat tinggal. Namun, ia malah terlibat dalam konflik yang terjadi di wilayah mereka.

programme.title: Elysium
programme.desc: Pada tahun 2154, orang kaya menghuni sebuah stasiun ruang angkasa dan orang miskin tinggal di planet Bumi. Seorang pria menjalankan misi untuk membawa kesetaraan bagi dunia nan bertolak belakang tersebut.

programme.title: The Brothers Grimm
programme.desc: Will dan Jake Grimm menyamar sebagai pengusir setan yang selalu berpindah tempat. Mereka lalu mendapati sebuah kutukan dunia dongeng yang menuntut keberanian sejati, bukan ritual palsu yang biasa mereka lakukan.

programme.title: Ali
programme.desc: Sebuah film biografi nominasi Oscar dari ikon tinju Muhammad Ali, yang berfokus pada kemenangan dan kontroversinya di antara tahun 1964-1974, termasuk saat ia beralih dari Cassius Clay menjadi Ali sang legenda.

programme.title: Ultraviolet
programme.desc: Sebuah kisah tentang seorang mutan genetik nan cantik yang menguasai seni bela diri dalam melindungi ras barunya, serta seorang anak laki-laki nan misterius.

programme.title: Twilight
programme.desc: Seorang gadis remaja tinggal bersama ayahnya di sebuah kota kecil dan jatuh cinta pada seorang lelaki misterius dengan rahasia nan mengejutkan. Mungkinkah ia ada hubungannya dengan kasus pembunuhan yang tengah terjadi?

programme.title: Ali
programme.desc: Sebuah film biografi nominasi Oscar dari ikon tinju Muhammad Ali, yang berfokus pada kemenangan dan kontroversinya di antara tahun 1964-1974, termasuk saat ia beralih dari Cassius Clay menjadi Ali sang legenda.

programme.title: The Karate Kid
programme.desc: Usai pindah ke kota baru, Daniel diganggu oleh beberapa anak laki-laki yang menguasai karate. Ia pun memutuskan untuk berlatih dari Tn. Miyagi. Kemudian, ia menyadari bahwa karate tak hanya sekadar seni bela diri.

programme.title: The Green Hornet
programme.desc: Setelah sang ayah wafat, Britt Reid mewarisi perusahaan ayahnya. Ia bekerja sama dengan mantan asisten sang ayah, Kato, untuk menjadi tim pemberantas kejahatan bertopeng.

programme.title: The Brothers Grimm
programme.desc: Will dan Jake Grimm menyamar sebagai pengusir setan yang selalu berpindah tempat. Mereka lalu mendapati sebuah kutukan dunia dongeng yang menuntut keberanian sejati, bukan ritual palsu yang biasa mereka lakukan.

programme.title: Miami Vice
programme.desc: Dua polisi yang tengah menyamar menyusun rencana untuk menggerebek jaringan pengedar narkoba. Namun, situasi tidak berjalan sesuai rencana ketika salah satu dari mereka jatuh cinta kepada bankir sang gembong narkoba.

programme.title: Total Recall
programme.desc: Selamat datang di Rekall, perusahaan yang bisa mengubah mimpi Anda menjadi kenyataan. Bagi seorang pekerja pabrik, Douglas Quaid, perjalanan di alam pikiran bisa menjadi pilihan sempurna untuk lari dari penatnya hidup.

programme.title: Pixels
programme.desc: Saksikan aksi petualangan spektakuler dari sekelompok mantan juara video gim dari tahun 1980-an yang bersatu untuk menyelamatkan dunia dari invasi alien.

programme.title: Collateral
programme.desc: Seorang pengemudi taksi disandera oleh seorang pembunuh bayaran yang melakukan serangkaian aksi pembunuhan selama satu malam di LA, dan ia harus menemukan cara untuk menyelamatkan diri dan satu korban terakhir.

programme.title: Minority Report
programme.desc: Berlatar di masa depan, para penjahat ditangkap bahkan sebelum mereka melakukan kejahatan. Seorang detektif harus membuktikan jika dirinya tak bersalah saat ia dituduh melakukan pembunuhan yang diduga akan ia lakukan.

programme.desc: John Cusack berperan sebagai seorang pejabat intelijen Amerika yang kembali ke Shanghai pada akhir tahun 1941 guna menyelidiki kematian seorang teman. Hal ini membawanya pada cinta dan konspirasi yang jauh lebih besar.

programme.title: Seattle Superstorm

programme.title: Miami Vice

programme.title: Blue Beetle
programme.desc: An ancient alien relic chooses a college graduate to be its symbiotic host. As a result, the young man finds himself in possession of a suit with incredible powers.

programme.title: Rocky V
programme.desc: Circumstances force Rocky to retire from boxing. However, he soon accepts to train a young boxer named Tommy Gunn at his older trainer Mickey Goldmill's gym.

programme.title: Crime Spree
programme.desc: A group of French thieves is tasked with stealing an expensive necklace from a home in Chicago. However, the robbery turns into a fiasco when they realize that the house belongs to a mafia kingpin.

programme.title: Non-Stop
programme.desc: A US air marshal receives threatening messages demanding that his airline transfer USD 150 million dollars to an offshore account, in the absence of which the passengers of his flight will be killed.

programme.title: Hollywood on Set
programme.desc: The key aspects of filmmaking are explored, with behind-the-scenes insights and intriguing interviews with prominent cast and crew members.

programme.title: Sinister 2
programme.desc: Courtney Collins, a single mother, relocates to a rural home with her twin sons. Later, she discovers it's inhabited by malevolent spirits connected to the sinister entity Bughuul.

programme.title: StreetDance 2
programme.desc: After an embaressing defeat, a street dancer, Ash, assembles the best dancers from all across the world for another around against the Invincible crew.

programme.title: The November Man
programme.desc: Peter, a former CIA officer, is assigned the task of protecting a valuable witness, Alice, who has secret information about a Russian presidential candidate.

programme.title: Skyfall
programme.desc: An ex-MI6 agent steals a hard drive with top-secret information to carry out a vendetta on Bond's overseer, M. Bond must face his past in a bid to try and save M.

programme.title: Sherlock Holmes
programme.desc: Sherlock Holmes and Dr Watson send Lord Henry Blackwood, a serial killer, to the gallows. However, they are shocked to learn that he is back from the dead and pursue him again.

programme.title: Mortal Kombat
programme.desc: To protect Earth from the Outworld, MMA fighter Cole Young sets out to find a group of fighters to defend the planet in a critical tournament.

programme.title: The Hunger Games: Mockingjay, Part 1
programme.desc: After putting an end to the dystopian Hunger Games, Katniss Everdeen and her friends attempt to rescue a brainwashed companion and free their nation from the control of President Coriolanus Snow.

programme.title: Mr. & Mrs. Smith
programme.desc: Tensions escalate when a married couple, trying to balance their mundane lives while hiding their true professions, are hired to assassinate each other.

programme.title: Mad Max: Fury Road
programme.desc: When in a post-apocalyptic wasteland, Max, a wanderer, joins the rebel warrior Imperator Furiosa against his will in order to dethrone an autocrat who controls water supply to the land.

programme.title: Johnny English
programme.desc: Johnny English, a bumbling British agent, teams up with an Interpol agent and attempts to locate a French billionaire who has stolen the crown jewels.
